     1	""" Distributor init file
     2	
     3	Distributors: you can add custom code here to support particular distributions
     4	of numpy.
     5	
     6	For example, this is a good place to put any BLAS/LAPACK initialization code.
     7	
     8	The numpy standard source distribution will not put code in this file, so you
     9	can safely replace this file with your own version.
    10	"""
    11	
    12	try:
    13	    import mkl
    14	    __mkl_version__ = "{MajorVersion}.{MinorVersion}.{UpdateVersion}".format(**mkl.get_version())
    15	except ImportError:
    16	    import warnings
    17	    warnings.warn(
    18	        "mkl-service package failed to import, therefore Intel(R) MKL "
    19	        "initialization ensuring its correct out-of-the box operation under "
    20	        "condition when Gnu OpenMP had already been loaded by Python process "
    21	        "is not assured. Please install mkl-service package, see "
    22	        "http://github.com/IntelPython/mkl-service", stacklevel=2)
